title: Implicit Bias in LLMs: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Word association tests (e.g., adapting the Implicit Association Test) for occupational stereotypes, coreference resolution tasks with ambiguous pronouns, and analysis of character descriptions, pronouns, and themes in task-oriented text generation (e.g., story generation and reference letters).

Evaluating decision-making tasks such as HR resume screening using names associated with specific racial groups, assessing healthcare treatment recommendations based on patient race, and measuring performance drops when the model is prompted to adopt a specific racial persona.
Measuring the degradation of the model's task performance (e.g., mathematical calculations and complex problem-solving) when instructed to adopt the identity of a physically disabled person.

Conducting matched guise probing experiments focusing on speakers of African American English (AAE) to determine if dialects influence model predictions and judgments regarding employability and criminality.
